items.computation: The letter states a fixed, explicit appointment date and time for the witness hearing (Mittwoch, 13.01.2027, 09:00 Uhr) at Amtsgericht Musterquedlin, Saal 104. No period calculation is needed; the date is taken as printed.

warnings: This is a witness summons (Ladung zum Termin als Zeuge), not a decision subject to Einspruch/Widerspruch/Klage; only the obligation to attend applies, with no remedy instructions given.

Unexcused absence can result in costs and an Ordnungsgeld under § 380 ZPO being imposed on the recipient — bring the summons and an official ID, or arrange a valid excuse with the court in advance if unable to attend.
